competences.description: Attacks the enemy and decreases its Attack Bar by 30% with a 50% chance. When used during the Thunderer state, you attack additionally with lower damage to enemies of the same attribute as the target.
Attacks all enemies 2 times to decrease their Attack Power for 2 turns with a 70% chance. When used during the Thunderer state, leaves a Branding effect for 2 turns with a 70% chance.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.
The target will receive 25% increased damage.

competences.description: Stuns the enemy for 1 turn with a 50% chance whenever you attack the enemy. While under the Thunderer state, decreases the enemy's Defense for 2 turns when you attack the enemy. If the target is stunned after the attack, the duration of the Thunderer state increases by 1 turn. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Falls under the Thunderer state that enhances your skills for 3 turns and instantly gains another turn. While under the Thunderer state, your attacks will always land as a Critical Hit. Once the Thunderer state ends, you become stunned for 1 turn. In addition, decreases the skill cooldown of [The Light Thunderer] by 2 turns each when you are not under the Thunderer state.

effets.description: Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
effets.note: When you are not under the Thunderer state

effets.description: Attack will always land as a Critical Hit
